summary: A Felucca mod that turns sound randomization into a themed "summoning": each roll calls one of 30 demons whose rank sets how far the sound is pushed from where it was.
features: Per-track "Ritual" mode; on at every power-up
Rerolls the whole track, the FM6 patch, or one ENV, LFO or FX area
Seven ranks set the reach, from small nudges to a full random patch
Each knob click on a page summons a new variation
Hold SAVE to undo; shared delay, reverb and chorus can't be undone
Otherwise stock Felucca; must be built from source to install
